description: The best products for a need, e.g. "top 5 smartphones" or "best airfryer under 150 euro", ranked by the Tryvon score: buyer rating (review-weighted, so a few 5-star reviews don't beat thousands of 4.6-star ones), popularity, value for money and delivery speed. Commission plays no part. Returns rating, review count, lowest price, shops and key specifications per product. Products without reviews are marked hasReviews=false.

category.description: Or a category key from search results (categoryKey), e.g. "smartphones".

max_delivery_days.description: Only offers the shop promises within this many working days (1 = next day).

query.description: What kind of product, e.g. "smartphone", "noise cancelling koptelefoon", "airfryer".

name: top_products
title: Top products
